name: kkron_city_aikido_teaching
description: kkron's teaching at City Aikido (fill-in Fridays for Nadeau; took over Richard Moon's Thursday evening class) and his role running the City Aikido and Aikido of Mountain View websites — asserted by kkron 2026-09-24, partially corroborated by Wayback captures of cityaikido.com schedule pages listing 'Joseph Arceneaux, Kenneth Kron' teaching Thursday 6:15-8:15pm (Dec 2004, Aug 2005, Nov 2006 captures), following Moon's Thursday class (2002-2003 captures) and preceding unnamed/Johnston slots (2007+). Also records DNS findings: cityaikido.com registered 2001-03-14 (Verisign RDAP; Apr 2001 capture is a Network Solutions parked page, so originally registered via Network Solutions); aikidomv.com and aikidomtview.com and aikidoofmarin.com are now unregistered (RDAP 404). Original registrant names are not publicly recoverable from free sources (whois history is paywalled: DomainTools/Whoxy/SecurityTrails).

nodes.label: City Aikido Thursday evening class (San Francisco)

metadata.note: Recurring weekly Thursday evening class at City Aikido (790 Eddy St, later 1339 Mission St). Richard Moon taught it as 'Jiu Waza (freestyle)' in 2002-2003; Joseph Arceneaux + Kenneth Kron co-taught it 2004-2006 after Moon went periodic; unnamed 'All Levels' 2007-08; Roy Johnston by 2010.

nodes.label: kkron took over Richard Moon's Thursday evening class at City Aikido when Moon stopped teaching it

metadata.claim_text: kkron states (2026-09-24) he took over Richard Moon's Thursday evening class at City Aikido when Moon stopped teaching it. Corroborated by Wayback captures: Moon held Thursday 6:15-8:00pm 'Jiu Waza (freestyle)' in 2002 and Thursday 7:15-8:30pm in Dec 2003; 'Joseph Arceneaux, Kenneth Kron' co-taught Thursday 6:15-8:15pm in Dec 2004, Aug 2005, and Nov 2006 captures; Moon reduced to 'check news page for Moon Sensei classes' from 2006.
metadata.corroboration: wayback:captures 2004/2005/2006 name Arceneaux+Kron in the Thursday slot previously held by Moon

nodes.label: kkron was fill-in teacher for Robert Nadeau on Fridays at City Aikido

metadata.claim_text: kkron states (2026-09-24) he was fill-in teacher for Bob Nadeau on Fridays at City Aikido. Not separately corroborated — archived schedules list Friday slots under 'Nadeau Sensei' or 'Staff', and fill-in teachers would not appear by name.

nodes.label: kkron ran both the City Aikido (cityaikido.com) and Aikido of Mountain View (aikidomv.com) websites

metadata.claim_text: kkron states (2026-09-24) he ran both the City Aikido and Aikido of Mountain View websites. Note on timing: the 2002 cityaikido.com site credits 'Arceneaux Consulting' (Joseph Arceneaux), and aikidomv.com credits 'Eric' (mvaikidoweb@comcast.net) in 2008-2011 captures — so kkron's role was likely later or shared. cityaikido.com was registered 2001-03-14 via Network Solutions (Apr 2001 capture is a NetSol parked page); aikidomv.com, aikidomtview.com, and aikidoofmarin.com are all now unregistered (RDAP 404). Original registrant names are not publicly recoverable from free sources.
